Abbreviation: APACHE: acute physiology and chronic health evaluation; CVP: central venous pressure; CK: creatine kinase; CRP: C-reactive protein; PaO2: partial pressure of arterial oxygen. variables with STATA command codebook, which showed that APACHE III, CVP, the number of quad- rats of infiltrates, CRP, CK and urine output contained missing values.

p3_b3.ocr: We followed several steps to perform the MI procedure: (1) the dataset was declared as marginal

p3_b4.ocr: long style, because it was a memory-efficient style. (2) All variables with missing values were registered

p3_b5.ocr: as imputed variable. (3) multivariate normal regression model was used for the imputation procedure.

p3_b6.ocr: Variables employed for imputation were those obtained within 24 hours after initiation of the study

p3_b7.ocr: including mortality outcome, age, gender, source of admission, type of patients, chronic dialysis, vaso-

p3_b8.ocr: pressor use, temperature, blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate and infection site. There were no

p3_b9.ocr: missing values for these variables. We created 20 imputations to reduce the simulation (Monte Carlo)
